items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Name that young man that died that lived in New Jersey that was such a beautiful person, a West Indian black man. [INTERVIEWEE] An arranger?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah -- we had Besford Hendrix, Burt Keys, Leroy Kirkland, Joe Mooney.
Name that young man that died that lived in New Jersey that was such a beautiful person, a West Indian black man.
